offering_description.value: Viasat provides satellite internet and secure connectivity to households, businesses, governments and militaries. It designs, builds and operates a satellite network that combines its own space and ground infrastructure with partner infrastructure. It also provides managed terrestrial networking and sells communications equipment.

quotes.quote: Viasat is a global communications company connecting homes, businesses, governments & militaries with satellite internet, connectivity solutions, & additional services.

Viasat designs, builds, and operates one of the world’s most advanced multi-orbit, multi-band satellite networks, integrating our space and ground infrastructure with that of world-class third-party partners, removing the limitations and risk of a single-network approach.

primary_products.value: communications terminals; satellite modems; network firewalls; software-defined wide-area networking equipment
